name: aniprotech-frontend-tests
description: Checks for the parts of the frontend that only fail at runtime. The Python suite covers the API; this covers the PDF generator, which is where a removed variable turns into a thrown exception that takes the invoice preview and the email attachment down together.

scripts.test: npm run test:pdf && npm run test:pagination && npm run test:logo && npm run test:form && npm run test:logosync && npm run test:mobilenav && npm run test:nav
